story_info.title: Toby Turtle and the Tangled Feather
story_info.subtitle: A gentle forest adventure
story_info.moral: Being gentle helps us protect nature.

main_character.name: Toby Turtle
main_character.appearance: Toby is a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers. He has a calm, unhurried expression.

supporting_characters.name: Pip Sparrow
supporting_characters.appearance: a small brown bird with a grey head, bright black eyes, and tiny orange feet.
supporting_characters.role: needs help freeing a feather for her nest

slides.title: A Walk in Sunny Forest
slides.text: Toby Turtle walked in Sunny Forest. The morning sun felt warm. He saw green leaves and pretty flowers. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he said. Toby liked to look closely. Then he heard a little "Chirp! Chirp!" It was Pip Sparrow. Pip looked very worried.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Toby in his favorite place, Sunny Forest, and the start of a small problem.

slides.title: Pip's Problem
slides.text: "Oh, Toby!" chirped Pip. "My softest feather for my nest is stuck!" She pointed to a thorny bush. A fluffy white feather was tangled deep inside. "I tried to pull it. But it just went deeper," Pip said sadly. She needed that feather for her cozy nest.
slides.speaker_notes: Pip explains her problem to Toby, highlighting the challenge.

slides.title: Toby's Thought
slides.text: Toby saw the feather. He knew pulling hard would not help. "Let us look carefully, Pip," Toby said. He slowly moved closer to the bush. Toby looked at the feather and the tiny thorns. He thought about how to set it free. He remembered his favourite saying.
slides.speaker_notes: Toby applies his thoughtful and patient personality to the problem.

slides.title: A Gentle Touch
slides.text: Toby used his smooth blue-green flipper. He very gently held a tiny thorny branch. He moved it just a little bit. Zip! The fluffy white feather came out! "You did it, Toby!" Pip chirped happily. Pip carefully picked up her soft feather.
slides.speaker_notes: Toby's gentle solution solves the problem, showing the 'love and protect nature' lesson.

slides.title: Happy in the Forest
slides.text: Pip gave Toby a happy chirp. "Thank you, friend!" she said. She flew off to make her nest cozy. Toby smiled. He felt good inside. Being gentle helps keep nature safe and happy. The Sunny Forest felt calm and kind.
slides.speaker_notes: A calm and comforting ending, reflecting on the lesson and Toby's happiness.
